input: Find music (instruments, bands, rock camp, choir, strings) summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville music summer camp 2026 2025 rock strings
2026 music summer camp Asheville north south east piano academy
Furman summer music camp 2026 residential teens

candidates.name: Asheville Music School
candidates.note: West Asheville; 2026 camps for ages 4–18 in rock, strings, ukulele, jazz, voice, Appalachian music and recording.

candidates.name: Music Academy Asheville / Rock Academy
candidates.note: West Asheville, Patton Avenue; weeklong band camps with instrument exploration and a Friday performance.

candidates.name: Asheville Conservatory
candidates.note: 2026 piano-and-art camps at the Biltmore studio on Hendersonville Road, plus preschool music exploration.

candidates.name: We Rock Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 rock camp ran July 20–24 at ArtSpace Charter School, 9 a.m.–4 p.m., followed by a camper showcase.

candidates.name: Asheville Junior Theater
candidates.note: 2025–2026 musical-theater camps included singing, choreography and musical performances; full-day and younger-child options.

candidates.name: Asheville Performing Arts Academy
candidates.note: Weeklong summer musical-theater performance camps with music, drama and dance instruction.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Center for the Arts
candidates.note: 2025–2026 children's performance-arts camps combined singing, music, dance and crafts with an end-of-week showcase.

candidates.name: Warren Wilson College — Swannanoa Gathering
candidates.note: Weeklong traditional-music workshops in summer 2026; youth ages 12 and older can attend.

candidates.name: NovusWay Ministries — Lutheridge
candidates.note: Youth summer camps include Music Week with children's singing programs; 2026 summer brochure available.

candidates.name: Hendersonville Music Academy
candidates.note: Summer 2026 beginner strings and string orchestra programs; orchestra for ages 7–17 met Thursday evenings.

candidates.name: Brevard Music Center
candidates.note: Residential summer music institute accepts teenage musicians beginning at age 14 for intensive study and performance.

candidates.name: Mars Hill University
candidates.note: Summer Music Camp ran June 14–19, 2026, with music study, rehearsals, performances and supervised recreation.

candidates.name: Tryon Fine Arts Center
candidates.note: PacJAM camp ran June 22–26, 2026, with Appalachian instruments, bluegrass, old-time music and crafts.

candidates.name: Presbyterian Association of Musicians
candidates.note: Worship & Music Conference includes supervised music programming for completed grades 3–12; 2027 conference announced.

candidates.name: First United Methodist Church of Morganton
candidates.note: 2025 Music & Arts Camp offered registration tracks for preschool/kindergarten and rising first grade and older.

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: Bluegrass camp for ages 12–19 announced July 5–9, 2027; also offered a 2026 string chamber-music festival.

candidates.name: Furman University
candidates.note: 2026 residential music camps included band and orchestra for ages 12–18, plus keyboard and voice programs.

candidates.name: Bob Jones University — EDUcamp
candidates.note: Senior Music camp offers choir, band, strings and piano study; overnight EDUcamp options serve grades 9–12.
